disposition_reason: Table 1 prints mean, SD, min and max Pb, As, Cr and Cd (µg/L) in raw milk from 10 individual cows on each of six farms, one agricultural control and five in an industrial city; Table 2 pools them by area.

study.design: Farm survey of individual-cow raw milk with drinking water, silage and soil; correlation with milk composition
study.origin: Five dairy farms in Tangshan (industrial city with steel, cement and waste incineration plants) and one control farm in Qiqihar (agricultural area), China
study.market: not applicable (milk taken from udders during milking)
study.period_text: autumn 2017 (Tangshan farms B-F) and spring 2018 (Qiqihar farm A)
study.method: Microwave HNO3/H2O2 digestion of 1 mL milk; ICP-MS (Agilent 7700x, helium mode)
study.lod_text: Milk LOD Pb 0.050, As 0.004, Cr 0.035, Cd 0.001 µg/L
study.qa: Spiked samples used to verify accuracy; recoveries not printed; no CRM reported

findings.group: farm A, Qiqihar agricultural control area (unpolluted), spring 2018
findings.notes: Per-litre result (µg/L, wet weight) kept unconverted; value_ugkg null. Values below the LOD were replaced by half the LOD in calculations (Section 2.2). Farms in industrial area significantly differ from control for Pb and Cd (P<0.01).

controls.control: farm location: agricultural control area vs industrial area
controls.outcome: Pb 0.16 vs 1.43 µg/L and Cd 0.04 vs 0.10 µg/L (both P<0.01, higher in industrial); As 0.10 vs 0.05 µg/L (higher on control farm, P<0.01); Cr 0.83 vs 0.88 µg/L (no difference)

regulatory_or_exposure.what: EU maximum level for lead in raw milk (EC 2006)

unresolved: pdftotext renders the µg/L unit as 'mg/L'; the page image (p. 3) confirms µg/L.
Minima printed below the LOD (As 0.002, Pb 0.03, Cr 0.02) reflect half-LOD substitution; text gives As range 0.004-1.53 µg/L.
Water, silage and soil concentrations not recorded as findings.
